title: Where Does Predictive Resilience Come From? Code and data for the simulation-based digital-twin assessment of hybrid 5G/6G-class and LEO satellite networks (revision R1)
description: Simulator, experiment and analysis code, frozen confirmation protocol, raw result files and manuscript-generation scripts for the revised manuscript JRESS-D-26-06464 (Reliability Engineering & System Safety). The raw results of the development and confirmation campaigns were produced with release v1.1-R1 and are unchanged in later releases; v1.4-R1 adds an exploratory control experiment (risk-free standby repair and rate-limited refresh). See README.md, section 8, for the release history.
